chunks: And from a sermon of his (peace be upon him) in which he mentions the beginning of the creation of the sky and the earth, and the creation of Adam (peace be upon him), and in it he mentions the Hajj.
ai.seo_question: What are the main themes covered in this specific sermon from Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: This passage introduces a sermon from Imam Ali’s *Khutbah al-Fatiha* (or the opening of the first sermon), establishing the theological foundation of Shia cosmology by linking the macrocosm of creation to the microcosm of human guidance. It underscores the continuity between divine revelation, the selection of prophets, and the establishment of Shariah, reflecting the Shia emphasis on the Imamate as the inheritor of prophetic knowledge. The mention of Hajj situates ritual practice within this broader cosmic and spiritual narrative, affirming its divine origin.
